notes.title: Game name change and all-in-one VR headset version online Sidequest notification
notes.content:
1. about the game name change
The title of the game, originally "Seed World", has been changed to "SubspaceHunter", which has the same name on sideqeust and 87VR.

2. Reasons for change
After half a year of development, Seed World has completed the preliminary gameplay verification and launched on the VR all-in-one platform, and entered the formal operation stage. In order to ensure the game experience of the majority of players and meet the needs of higher quality game content development, it will be operated by a more professional game studio.

3. the all-in-one version is now on the shelves
The all-in-one version of the game is now available on Sidequest, and the game can be found by searching for Subspace Hunter on Sidequest and Virtual Hunter on 87VR. At present, the game supports devices: Quest2, Quest Pro, and the game provides 20 hours of game flow. The game now includes 13 dueling enemies with different fighting styles, as well as four full annihilation battle modes. It offers dozens of different types of weapons, as well as a complete three-dimensional interactive system. PICO version (Q3), PC version (Q4)

4. Game summary
World MR Action game "Unreal Hunter" is a MR+VR dual mode action game developed by the Unreal origin, players need to use firearms, cold weapons, magic arbitrary combination and from the subspace invasion to the real world of the enemy to fight. The game supports pure gesture tracking without controller play, while supporting single player mode and multiplayer online play mode.

5.  Overview of the game
In 2023, subspace cracks appear around the world, and many alien world demons invade the real plane. For this reason, Virtual Origin developed a game so that humans can see the enemies of subspace through special glasses, and fight with them to hunt alien world demons, and guard the real plane.
The game provides cold weapons, magic, firearms three major combat schools, players can arbitrarily combine them to form their own unique fighting style, clever use of different fighting methods to fight with the enemy. Players need to observe different enemy fighting ways to make different battle changes, after long-term training and actual combat to grow into a qualified "virtual hunter", defend our reality plane.

6. Description of player rights and interests
The original Seed World player rights will be inherited to SubspaceHunter, including the original participation in the crowdfunding rights will be fully inherited.

7. Official website and social groups
Website：https://xk.seed-xr.tech/

8. Plan
The game still needs 8-12 months to improve, and we have the following development tasks planned
1. Online multiplayer online games :PVE, PVP
2. LAN MR Multiplayer online game :PVE, PVP
3. The virtual space corresponds to the enemy style of the VR scene
4. Improved magic system
5. Better firearms systems
6. Improved sword strike system
7. The player's achievements
8. Player character growth system
9.RPG game systems
10. Gun custom modification system
11. Magic custom makeover system
